name: Chongqing Yufu Holdings Group Co., Ltd. (重庆渝富控股集团有限公司)
via: 100% held by the Chongqing Municipal State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Chongqing SASAC), its controlling shareholder and actual controller
note: Chongqing's state capital-operation platform, established 2004. Southwest Securities' January 2025 acquisition report states the Chongqing Municipal SASAC holds 100% of Yufu Holdings and is its controlling shareholder and actual controller; the same report's core-enterprise table lists Yufu Capital at 100.00% under Yufu Holdings.
